rationale: Vincent founded Novis and was a founding member of Figma during its early growth (2012-2016), while Hana is currently a Software Engineer Intern at Figma working across full-stack and systems domains. This shared Figma connection, combined with Vincent's founder experience and Hana's early-stage development work in design-tools, creates a natural mentorship opportunity where Vincent can offer insight into Figma's trajectory and early-stage building.
intro_message: Vincent, meet Hana Hassan — she's a Software Engineer Intern at Figma, the company you helped found, and is building across full-stack and systems work.
